mapper.select: select count(*) as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where s.status = 'PICKING') as picking_cnt, count(*) filter (where s.plan_date < #{today}) as late_cnt from wms_ship s where s.status in ('DRAFT', 'PICKING') and s.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
mapper.sql: with res as ( select r.plant_cd, r.item_id, sum(r.qty) as reserved from () r where 1 = 1 and r.plant_cd = #{plantCd} group by r.plant_cd, r.item_id having sum(r.qty) > 0 ), av as ( select s.plant_cd, s.item_id, sum(s.qty) as qty from inv_stock s left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id where (s.plant_cd, s.item_id) in (select plant_cd, item_id from res) and s.qty > 0 and (s.lot_id is null or lm.hold_yn = 'N') and group by s.plant_cd, s.item_id ), over as ( select res.plant_cd, res.item_id, res.reserved, coalesce(av.qty, 0) as avail from res left join av on av.plant_cd = res.plant_cd and av.item_id = res.item_id where res.reserved > coalesce(av.qty, 0) )
mapper.select: select o.plant_cd, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, o.reserved, o.avail from over o join mst_item i on i.item_id = o.item_id order by o.reserved - o.avail desc, o.plant_cd, i.item_cd limit #{limit}
